lines.text: He is not playing the guitar.
He often plays it and he plays very well.
but he is not playing the guitar now.
(一 般 现 在 时 )
现在 进行 时 (lam doing) 表示 现在 或 说 话 的 时 刻 正在 发 生 的 事情 :
口 Please be quiet. I’m working. (而 不 用 I work)
© Tom is having a shower at the moment. (而 不 用 Tom has)
O Take an umbrella with you. It’s raining.
口 You can turn off the television. I’m not watching it.
0 Why are you under the table? What are you doing?
一 般 现 在 时 (Ldo) 表示 一 般 性 的 事实 、 经 常 或 有 时 发 生 的 事情 ，
C1 I work every day from 9 o’clock to 5.30.
O Tom has a shower every morning.
O It rains a lot in winter.
0 I don’t watch television very often.
口 What do you usually do at the weekend?
下 列 动词 不 用 于 现在 进行 时 (Lam ing).
这 些 动 词 可 用 于 一 般 现 在 时 (I want / do you like? 等 )
O I’m tired. I want to go home. (而 不 用 I’m wanting)
‘Yes, but I don’t remember her name.’
O I don’t understand. What do you mean?
